messages:
omar: Heads-up — I'm on PTO next Wed (May 22). Need someone to facilitate ARB that week. Slot is 10:00-11:00am PT. Main focus: RFC triage + platform-standards follow-up. Pinging folks who usually cover: @lina @chun @devon

lina: I can take it but need a quick handoff doc from whoever covers the chair. Happy to run the RFCs and post pre-reads.

chun: I can cover the second half (platform standards) if lina wants the RFC block. Or I can split 50/50.

devon: +1 to cover if needed. I can also add the vendor compatibility item (10m) to agenda — think it's relevant for the scheduling discussion.

omar: Thanks — appreciate it. Agenda draft below, please edit and add PR/RFC numbers. I'll update the 'chair notes' template before I go.

omar: ```
Agenda
- 10:00 — quick intros & outstanding actions (5m)
- 10:05 — RFC #3425 (owner: lina) — rollout constraints (15m)
- 10:20 — RFC #3490 (owner: chun) — infra changes (15m)
- 10:35 — Platform standards: GPU scheduling & burst policy (owner: devon) (15m)
- 10:50 — Any other business + action assignment (10m)

Pre-reads:
- https://rfc.internal/3425
- https://rfc.internal/3490

Note-taker: assign separately (not facilitator). Add deploy-canary flag in invite if any RFC touches live infra.
```

devon: Created a tentative invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=arb-proposed-1900246800 — can we add "ARB facilitator" to description and assign a note-taker? I can add @narayana as backup.

narayana: happy to be backup note-taker. Quick ask: can the meeting title be explicit — e.g., "ARB — Platform Standards & RFCs" so people know it's a review slot not a brainstorming session?

omar: Agreed. lina/chun — do we want note-taking to rotate or to be separate? My preference: separate note-taker so the facilitator can focus on timekeeping.

lina: I can take notes for my RFC section. chun — can you capture platform actions during your section?

chun: Yep. I'll also create follow-up tickets in the infra board during the meeting so nothing gets lost.

arb-bot: Reminder: facilitator swap requested by @omar. Suggested assignment: facilitator=@lina, backup=@narayana.

devon: :thumbsup: I'll update the invite title + description and attach pre-reads by EOD Monday. Will add vendor compatibility as a 10m slot after RFCs.

omar: Perfect. Leaving a tiny checklist for whoever picks this up: add pre-reads to invite, set calendar title to 'ARB — Platform Standards & RFCs', mark note-taker, add deploy-canary flag if needed, and paste the chair notes template into the invite. Thanks all!
